scope: Existing independently reviewed finding dimensions registered against exact current source/record/focus/context fingerprints. This is not a whole-row, whole-book or semantic-completeness certificate.

validation.policy: Only current explicit source reviews adjudicate candidates or supersede known defects. Changed/missing recipes do not automatically resolve a known finding. No finding-free semantic pass is inferred.

normalizationTransfer: All 2161 serialized normalized record projections remain unchanged through the validator-only repairs, excluding derived per-record review status. Full physical fingerprints still include every ordered focus part.

reviewIndex.scope: Typed unit only; preserve all other source and evidence dimensions.
